comments.text: Depends on the genre, me personally I think this type of drumming is kinda ass (except for the bell hit), but you do you… the type of metal drumming I like is defeated sanity (for accents, fills and time signatures) or devourment (for that super fast cryptopsy blasting and buzz roll blasting) you should also listen to some grind bands for speed such as sulfuric cautery or last days of humanity… if you want more groovy grind I would recommend putrid Stu… the drummer (and now guitarist) for sanguisugabogg (I’m pretty sure they played with lorna shore?) basically carries the band (no hate to the other members)
